verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair question for a SaaS feedback platform, but the evidence pack documents no CLI, CI integration, or headless execution mode. The only related items are an API Reference page title with no content and an MCP server that is used interactively through chat clients like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor with sign-in. Neither documents running Canny headlessly in CI, so this is absence of evidence for an applicable capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
